name: LightSync
author: Sven Wagener
description: Shows LightSync's Philips Hue Entertainment synchronization state in the Omarchy bar. LightSync must be installed separately; this plugin never installs software or starts screen capture on its own.

barWidget.description: Hue Entertainment sync state. Left click opens LightSync; right click explicitly starts or stops synchronization.

schema.label: Show while synchronization is idle
schema.description: Errors and active synchronization remain visible when this is off.
